title: Dune Launches Real-Time Feeds as Tokenized Equity Volume Tops $37B in Q3
why_it_matters: Standardized real-time data can make fragmented tokenized-equity markets easier for asset managers, brokers and market makers to monitor alongside listed instruments.
caption:
RWA WIRE // MARKET INFRASTRUCTURE

Dune Launches Real-Time Feeds as Tokenized Equity Volume Tops $37B in Q3

Dune’s new institutional feeds normalize trades from more than 200 onchain venues, while the company reports over $37 billion in tokenized stock and ETF volume during Q3 2026.
